svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 181 mm lengths of 20 x 3 mm flat bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round both ends to a 10 mm radius (file to a scribed circle).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 6.6 mm: one hole 10 mm from each end (161.2 mm apart) and a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: third 24 mm from the lower hole, on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the two posts clamped together so the holes match.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the lower end bolts to the outside of the plate clip with two M6

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolts, which hold the post rigid. The upper end bolts to the high

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: panel clip with one M6 bolt, which is the panel's hinge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The post leans back 10 degrees from vertical and passes 2 mm in front

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: hole centres 161 mm and 24 mm apart, within 0.5 mm.
